aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome for Android led browser versions (tablet) in Brazil at 73.98% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Chrome iPad ranked second at 9.43%, followed by Safari iPad at 9.26%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (tablet) in Brazil?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android leads at 73.98% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/tablet/brazil.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (tablet) in Brazil?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (73.98%), Chrome iPad (9.43%), Safari iPad (9.26%) in October 2026.
